dict.string: Love is in the air.. Wait, no - that’s a pudgy baby with a deadly weapon.
Legend says anyone she smacks with her staff becomes as beautiful as she.
Ladies and gentlemen, here comes &RSeducThor! Nobody can resist his charms. &YNOBODY! Not even you...
